notes.title: Update is already in game!
notes.content:
Hello, guys!

We made some new things for you in Drift King:

1. Added new route - GreenTrack, which is best suited for drift.
2. Physics realism was highly modified, especially the deceleration and weight distribution of auto.
3. Players accounts security system has been improved.

Thank you for playing and stay tuned for new game updates!

Wish you an awesome drift!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830194/3e744c147f1d145cb16ecd66ff1b0cd96aed248b.png[/img]
